#### ACRAFT-01 · مخطط أولي ومنظمات بصرية ملائمة · Low-fi wireframe and ADHD-friendly visual organizers · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** إنتاج مخططات ASCII ومنظمات Mermaid مبسطة. — Produce ASCII or sketch wireframes and simple Mermaid organizers for focus.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** User wants screen wireframe, whiteboard sketch or task breakdown visual.
- **كيف / how:** 1. Default to ASCII wireframe; hand-drawn HTML on request. 2. Keep few nodes, color-code, chunk steps. 3. Mermaid for timelines, flows, checklists. 4. Iterate sketch until recognized. **أرقام / params:** style

#### ACRAFT-08 · بطاقة إخبارية مرسومة بأسلوب ثابت (موجّه صورة + SVG قابل للتعديل) · Fixed-style doodle card-news: image prompt plus editable SVG twin · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يرسم بطاقة شرح أو تحذير بأسلوب ثابت لا يتغير، ويسلّم موجّه صورة إنجليزياً وملف SVG بالنص نفسه لتعديله في Figma أو Canva. — Draws an explainer or warning card in one locked house style and ships two twins: an English image-model prompt and an SVG with the same text as editable layers.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** بطاقة إخبارية، كارد نيوز، بطاقة شرح مرسومة / card news, doodle explainer card, issue card
- **كيف / how:** 1) Lock the style sheet before drawing: one ink colour (#1A1A1A-ish), two neutral fills, one background treatment (flat cream or a vertical grey gradient), and exactly ONE accent colour reserved for the single key object. 2) Lock the layout as ratios of the canvas: inset frame about 2%, drawing zone top 3-62%, headline block bottom-left from about 7% margin, or title 9-17% / body 24-38% / diagram 45-90% for explainer cards. 3) Text the user gave is used verbatim; a reference image only tells you the subject, never copy its composition. 4) Explainer rules: things removed, saved or not yet existing are drawn as dashed outlines; emphasis is 2-3 short radial strokes; causes left, results right; body line 2 starts with an arrow. 5) Output the prompt in one fenced block with every in-image string as reading exactly: "...", plus the SVG with <text> elements in an OFL handwriting font. **أرقام / params:** accent colour, layout ratios, headline lines
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`fonts:arabic`](../requirements.md#req-fonts-arabic)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1094-akbun-draw/2417-akbun-draw-cartoon-b` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1094-akbun-draw/2416-akbun-draw-cardnews-cream`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas-5000 mining 2026-10-23 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas @ 99bb108d): akbun-draw/akbun-draw-cartoon-b (#2417); akbun-draw/akbun-draw-cardnews-cream (#2416) · theme image-design-media · 2 supporting skills · SKILL.md read in full as inert text: skills/1094-akbun-draw/2417-akbun-draw-cartoon-b, skills/1094-akbun-draw/2416-akbun-draw-cardnews-cream

#### ACRAFT-09 · صفحات ويبتون بشخصية ثابتة وألوان باستيل · Webtoon / essay-toon pages with a locked character sheet · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يحوّل قصة أو خاطرة إلى صفحات ويبتون عمودية بشخصية ثابتة الملامح، مع سيناريو صفحات وموجّه صورة لكل صفحة وطبقة نص SVG. — Turns a story or short essay into vertical webtoon pages with a fixed-look character, a page script, one image prompt per page and an SVG text layer.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** ويبتون، قصة مصورة، كوميك، رسم قصة / webtoon, comic page, essay toon, illustrated story
- **كيف / how:** 1) Write the page script first (pages, panels, narration, dialogue) and show it when you invented the story. 2) Character sheet: protagonist and counterpart described once; crowd figures faceless. 3) Canvas 4:5 (1080x1350) or tall page; layout per page type: two contrasting scenes = two panels split by a slightly tilted divider; big emotion = one borderless panel on white; dialogue = upper bodies plus hand-drawn balloons. 4) Style lock: thin warm-grey wobbly line, transparent watercolour or flat fills, 3-4 colours per page, one warm accent, manga symbols (sweat drop, motion arcs) used sparingly. 5) Narration is calm and factual; the feeling lives in the picture and in at most one short inner-thought bubble (about 10 characters) per page. 6) Keep in-image text short (models misspell long lines) and duplicate it in the SVG so wrong letters can be covered. **أرقام / params:** panels per page, palette, narration voice
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1094-akbun-draw/2423-akbun-draw-webtoon-b` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1094-akbun-draw/2424-akbun-draw-webtoon-c`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas-5000 mining 2026-10-23 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas @ 99bb108d): akbun-draw/akbun-draw-webtoon-b (#2423); akbun-draw/akbun-draw-webtoon-c (#2424) · theme image-design-media · 2 supporting skills · SKILL.md read in full as inert text: skills/1094-akbun-draw/2423-akbun-draw-webtoon-b, skills/1094-akbun-draw/2424-akbun-draw-webtoon-c

#### ACRAFT-10 · قصة مصورة وثائقية: مقابلة أولاً وجملة شخصية تُنسخ حرفياً · Documentary story scenes: interview first, verbatim CHARACTER sentence · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يرسم قصة حقيقية مشهداً بمشهد دون اختراع أحداث: يسأل أولاً ثم يثبّت وصف كل شخصية في جملة تُنسخ في كل موجّه. — Illustrates a real story scene by scene without inventing events: asks first, then pins each character in one sentence copied into every prompt.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** قصة حقيقية مرسومة، مشاهد متتالية بنفس الشخصية / story illustration series, consistent character across scenes
- **كيف / how:** 1) No material, no drawing: ask when/where, who, what happened (start, event, end), the mood and how many scenes. 2) At most 4 characters with distinct faces; everyone else is a faceless mid-grey silhouette (near) or light outline ghost (far). 3) Write one English CHARACTER sentence per lead (hair, hat, glasses, build, clothes) and paste it word for word into every scene where they appear, because the image model has no memory between prompts. 4) One scene = one message; emotion through body (raised arms, hunched posture); a big metaphor prop (mountain, seed, scale) can be the hero of a concept scene. 5) Deliver a scene table (number, caption, in-image text, composition) for approval, then one fenced prompt per scene with a DO NOT list (realistic render, flat vector, pure white, extra faces). **أرقام / params:** scene count, lead characters ≤4
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1094-akbun-draw/2425-akbun-draw-webtoon-d` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1094-akbun-draw/2421-akbun-draw-storytellingimage`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas-5000 mining 2026-10-23 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas @ 99bb108d): akbun-draw/akbun-draw-webtoon-d (#2425); akbun-draw/akbun-draw-storytellingimage (#2421) · theme video-motion · 2 supporting skills · SKILL.md read in full as inert text: skills/1094-akbun-draw/2425-akbun-draw-webtoon-d, skills/1094-akbun-draw/2421-akbun-draw-storytellingimage

#### ACRAFT-11 · رسم توضيحي للكتب بقوالب تخطيط ثابتة ونص محدد حرفياً · Book and sketchbook-card illustration with fixed layout templates · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يختار قالب تخطيط من مجموعة ثابتة (شريط أيقونات، تكبير، مقارنة…) ويرسم بأسلوب رمادي بنقطة لون واحدة، مع تحديد كل نص داخل الصورة حرفاً بحرف. — Picks one of a small fixed set of layouts (icon strip, zoom-in, comparison...) and draws in monogray with one accent, spelling out every in-image string exactly.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** رسومات كتاب، رسم توضيحي لمفهوم، بطاقة سكتشبوك / book illustration, concept sketch card, explainer drawing
- **كيف / how:** 1) Choose the layout from a fixed catalogue instead of free composition, and reuse its spacing numbers. 2) Palette: dark-grey ink line, flat greys, one orange (or teal) accent on 1-3 spots only. 3) Sketchbook card anatomy: optional index number top-left, UPPERCASE handwritten title, optional subtitle in brackets, short underline, 1-2 line description, 2-4 checklist items, then a pencil drawing in the lower two thirds inside a thin frame. 4) The scene carries mood, a bold geometric overlay carries the definition (dashed ellipse for orbit, arrows for movement, zoom circle for detail, frame-in-frame for composition). 5) Every in-image string is written as reading exactly: "..."; prompt in English, labels in the user's language, kept short. **أرقام / params:** layout id, accent spots
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1094-akbun-draw/2415-akbun-draw-book-illustration` · `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1094-akbun-draw/2420-akbun-draw-sketchbook-card`

#### ACRAFT-12 · مشهد قلم رصاص هادئ بلون واحد · Quiet pencil scene with a single colour accent · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يرسم لحظة ساكنة بقلم رصاص رمادي على ورق كريمي مع مساحة فارغة كبيرة ولون واحد فقط على قطعة صغيرة تحمل المعنى. — Draws one still moment in grey pencil on cream paper with large empty space and a single colour on one small meaningful prop.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** رسم هادئ بالقلم الرصاص، لوحة بسيطة حزينة أو تأملية / quiet pencil drawing, minimal contemplative illustration
- **كيف / how:** 1) Pick the stillest moment of the input and reduce it to 1-3 subjects. 2) Put them small on a ground line in the lower part; leave the top two thirds and the space around them empty. 3) One subject sits off-centre; several are split left/right. 4) Give one small prop a teal (#2E7D8C-like) accent; everything else greyscale pencil. 5) People only from behind or in profile, no front faces or emotion symbols, no text in the image. 6) Fill only the <...> slots of a fixed prompt template; never edit the style words. **أرقام / params:** subjects 1-3, accent prop
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1094-akbun-draw/2419-akbun-draw-quiet-pencil`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas-5000 mining 2026-10-23 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas @ 99bb108d): akbun-draw/akbun-draw-quiet-pencil (#2419) · theme prompt-skill-engineering · 1 supporting skills · SKILL.md read in full as inert text: skills/1094-akbun-draw/2419-akbun-draw-quiet-pencil

#### ACRAFT-13 · رسومات مدونة سفر: مصغّرة وخريطة مسار ومشهد · Travel-blog illustration kit: thumbnail, route sketch, scene · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يولّد مصغرة وخريطة مسار مبسطة ومشهداً لمقالة سفر بألوان محددة الأدوار، ولا يضيف جغرافيا لم ترد في النص. — Produces a thumbnail, a simplified route map and scene art for a travel post with role-coded colours, never adding geography the text did not give.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** صور مدونة سفر، خريطة رحلة مرسومة، غلاف مقال / travel blog thumbnail, illustrated route map
- **كيف / how:** 1) Formats: thumbnail 1:1 (16:9 on request) with short title, route sketch 3:4 with numbers only, scene 4:3 with no text. 2) Colours by role: cream paper, grey confirmed paths, three route colours (leaf green, purple, orange), greens for trees, sky blue for water, ink for lines and letters; thumbnail background chosen by subject (forest teal, sea blue, old town brown, cafe magenta, market olive). 3) Paths are rough crayon strokes; props flat shapes with no outline; people only as 1-3 faceless silhouettes. 4) Keep at least 35% of the canvas empty; title height 8-12% of canvas, subtitle 40-50% of the title, safe margin 8%. 5) Places, order and connections come only from the input; without directions draw a top-to-bottom visit order, never invent roads, coastlines or walking times. **أرقام / params:** format, route count ≤3
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1094-akbun-draw/2422-akbun-draw-travel-blog`

#### ACRAFT-14 · نظام بصري للكتاب: دليل فني ورسوم بالكود وحلقة رفض · Book visual system: art bible, code-rendered figures, art-director loop · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يضبط شكل كل صور الكتاب بدليل فني واحد، ويرسم المخططات والرسوم البيانية بالكود لا بنماذج التوليد، ويرفض الصور المخالفة ويعيدها. — Keeps every book image consistent through one art bible, renders diagrams and charts in code instead of diffusion, and rejects and regenerates off-spec images.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** صور كتاب، رسوم كتاب متسقة، مخططات للكتاب / book images, consistent illustrations for a book, figure plan
- **كيف / how:** 1) Write art-bible.md once: look, palette, medium, composition rules, character and setting sheets. 2) Compile one structured image spec into each backend's prompt syntax rather than hand-writing prompts per model. 3) Diagrams, charts, technical drawings and map bases are never generated by diffusion: Mermaid / D2 / Graphviz to SVG, matplotlib or Vega-Lite from a data file. 4) Plan figures in the outline; the writer places references and captions while drafting. 5) A reviewer reads every generated image, scores it against the art bible and regenerates with a corrected prompt. 6) Pre-export check: dimensions, aspect, size, alt text, broken references, manifest coverage. **أرقام / params:** art bible, figure plan
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`graphviz`](../requirements.md#req-graphviz) · [`pip:matplotlib`](../requirements.md#req-pip-matplotlib) · [`npm:mermaid`](../requirements.md#req-npm-mermaid)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under Apache-2.0; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1376-velith/3231-book-visuals`
- **المصدر / source:** KOSIF Atlas-5000 mining 2026-10-23 (https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas @ 99bb108d): velith/book-visuals (#3231) · theme image-design-media · 1 supporting skills · SKILL.md read in full as inert text: skills/1376-velith/3231-book-visuals

#### ACRAFT-23 · شرح بصري بصيغة واحدة مناسبة للسؤال · Visual explanation: one format chosen by the question · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يجيب عن «وضّح لي» برسم واحد مناسب (شجرة استدعاء، مخطط Mermaid، فرق كود…) مبني فقط على ما ثبت. — Answers 'show me' with one fitting visual (call tree, Mermaid diagram, focused diff...) built only from verified facts.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** وضّح بالرسم، ارسم لي مخطط، اشرح بصرياً / show me, sketch it, visualize this flow
- **كيف / how:** 1) Name the question the visual must answer. 2) Pick one format: pseudocode for logic and state transitions; indented call tree for runtime flow; shallow tree for ownership; Mermaid for actors and data flow; focused diff for a proposed change; HTML only when asked or previewable. 3) Extract only verified calls, files, states and actors. 4) One labelled visual next to the sentence it supports, plus one or two sentences of explanation. 5) Mark unknowns as unknown, never fill gaps with plausible architecture. **أرقام / params:** format
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`npm:mermaid`](../requirements.md#req-npm-mermaid)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2212-majestic-misc/8300-show-me`

#### ACRAFT-02 · نظام ألوان يدعم الوصولية والوضع الداكن · Color system with accessibility and dark mode · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تصميم تدرجات ألوان للعلامة والحياد والحالات تحقق التباين في الوضعين الفاتح والداكن. — Design brand, neutral and status colour ramps that meet contrast needs in light and dark modes.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Choosing a palette, status semantics, dark-mode, colour-blind support.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Pick brand primary and a neutral ramp. 2) Define success/warning/error semantics with icon or text backup. 3) Check pairs against 4.5:1 text and 3:1 UI. 4) Re-derive dark mode rather than inverting. 5) Test with colour-blind simulation.

#### ACRAFT-03 · اختبار تحمل الواجهة للمحتوى المتطرف · Content-stress and edge-case UI hardening · 📄 موصوف / documented only

- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Before shipping components, i18n or RTL checks.
- **كيف / how:** 1) List variable content slots. 2) Test extremes: long, empty, huge, multi-line. 3) Define truncation/wrap rules. 4) Provide image fallbacks. 5) Verify RTL and expanded translations.

#### ACRAFT-04 · تخطيط جشتالت: الشبكة والمحاذاة والتجميع · Gestalt layout: grid, alignment, grouping · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تطبيق المحاذاة والشبكات والتقارب والتشابه لتنظيم التخطيط. — Apply alignment, grid systems, proximity and similarity so layouts read as organized groups.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Layout review, form field grouping, picking columns/gutters/breakpoints.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Align every element to shared edges. 2) Choose columns, gutters, breakpoints and a baseline grid. 3) Group by proximity: gap between groups larger than within. 4) Use similarity for same-function items. 5) Keep labels close to their fields.

#### ACRAFT-05 · تدقيق التسلسل البصري والمسافات · Refactoring-UI hierarchy and spacing audit · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تدقيق واجهة من حيث التسلسل والمسافات واللون والعمق وتقييمها بقائمة فحص. — Audit a UI for hierarchy, spacing, color and depth and score it with a yes/no checklist.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** UI looks amateur, spacing/colour inconsistency, component styling review.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Judge hierarchy in grayscale/blurred first. 2) Limit emphasis levers (size, weight, colour) to one or two per element. 3) Use spacing scale 4/8/16/24/32/48/64 with group gaps larger than inner gaps. 4) Cap text width at 45-75 chars. 5) Score = round(passed/8*10) from 8 checks. 6) Add colour and shadows last. **أرقام / params:** screenshot or code

#### ACRAFT-06 · تدقيق الضجيج البصري وإزالة الزخرفة · Signal-to-noise decoration audit · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** إزالة الزخرفة الزائدة وتوزيع التأكيد بحيث يكسب كل عنصر مكانه. — Remove or densify decoration and budget emphasis so each cue earns its place.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Cluttered or sterile screens, deciding what to delete.

#### ACRAFT-07 · قواعد الخط والمقروئية للويب · Typography and legibility rules for web · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** اختيار الخطوط والأحجام والمقاييس وطول السطر لمقروئية أفضل. — Choose typefaces, sizes, scales and line lengths for legible web typography.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** Setting type scale, readability complaints, font pairing.
- **كيف / how:** 1) Pick a modular type scale. 2) Body size at least 16px, line-height about 1.5. 3) Line length 45-75 characters. 4) Limit to 1-2 families and few weights. 5) Establish typographic hierarchy via size/weight contrast.

#### ACRAFT-15 · تصميم الأيقونات بالتشابه والإغلاق البصري · Icon design by resemblance and Gestalt closure · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يصمم أيقونات تشبه ما تمثله أو تعتمد على إكمال العين للشكل الناقص، ويعرف متى يفشل التبسيط. — Designs icons that look like what they mean or let the eye complete a partial outline, and knows when simplification fails.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** تصميم أيقونة، أيقونات واضحة، شعار بمساحة سلبية / icon design, negative-space logo, partial-outline icon
- **كيف / how:** 1) Use resemblance when the object has a stable, widely known look (camera, lock, folder); switch to a convention icon when the thing is abstract. 2) Distinguish near neighbours by one decisive feature (camera vs video: add the record dot or a film frame). 3) Closure: suggest the shape with a partial outline or negative space; the viewer completes it, which lowers visual weight. 4) Do not rely on closure when completion costs the user effort in high-stakes UI, or when the icon becomes so reduced it is ambiguous. 5) Test at the smallest real size and with people who have not seen the brief. **أرقام / params:** icon size, metaphor
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

#### ACRAFT-16 · نظام ألوان دلالي: درجات الحالة ودور واحد لكل لون · Semantic colour system: status ramps, one role per colour · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يبني ألوان الحالة والفئات والعلامة التجارية بحيث يعني كل لون شيئاً واحداً فقط. — Builds status, category and brand colours so each colour means exactly one thing.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** ألوان الحالة، نظام ألوان، ألوان نجاح وخطأ / status colours, semantic palette, colour tokens
- **كيف / how:** 1) Separate three encodings: status (success, warning, error, info), category (project tags, teams) and brand role (primary CTA, accent, light emphasis). 2) Give each status a ramp: 50 tinted background, 300 border or icon, 500 main use, 700 text on tint, 900 text on dark. 3) Rules: one colour per role; destructive red never used for marketing emphasis; category hues never reused as status. 4) Category palettes: 5-7 distinguishable hues at most, then add shape or label. 5) Never rely on hue alone; pair with icon or text and check contrast. 6) Document every colour and its role on one spec page. **أرقام / params:** ramp steps 50/300/500/700/900
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

#### ACRAFT-17 · مقاييس الوضوح والقراءة: التباين والتباعد وطول السطر · Legibility and readability numbers: contrast, spacing, measure · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يضبط تباين النص وتباعد الحروف والأسطر وطول السطر بقيم مرجعية قابلة للقياس. — Sets text contrast, tracking, leading and line length to measurable reference values.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** النص غير مقروء، تباين، حجم الخط، تباعد الأسطر / text hard to read, contrast ratio, line height
- **كيف / how:** 1) Contrast: 4.5:1 normal text, 3:1 large text (18pt or 14pt bold) and UI graphics, 7:1 for AAA or poor viewing; check with a contrast tool or axe/Lighthouse. 2) Measure: 45-75 characters per line for prose, about 66 ideal. 3) Leading: headings 1.1-1.3, body 1.5-1.7, UI labels 1.2-1.4. 4) Loosen tracking slightly on ALL-CAPS and small text, tighten large display type; avoid long all-caps navigation. 5) Paragraph spacing large enough to see chunks. 6) Legibility (each glyph) is not readability (sustained reading): a display face may pass one and fail the other. **أرقام / params:** contrast 4.5/3/7; measure 45-75; leading 1.5-1.7
- **يحتاج / needs:** [`npm:axe`](../requirements.md#req-npm-axe)
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

#### ACRAFT-18 · التدرج الطباعي بسلم مقاسات · Typographic hierarchy from a modular type scale · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يبني تسلسل العناوين والنص من سلم نسب ثابت ووزن الخط بدلاً من أحجام عشوائية. — Builds heading and body ranks from a fixed ratio scale plus weight instead of arbitrary sizes.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** عناوين غير واضحة، سلم خطوط، أحجام الخط / type scale, heading hierarchy, font sizes
- **كيف / how:** 1) Pick one ratio for the product: 1.125 dense app UI, 1.2 gentle software UI, 1.25 general web default, 1.333 editorial, 1.414 print, 1.5 magazine, 1.618 hero/marketing. 2) Generate tokens display, h1-h4, body-lg, body, body-sm, caption, micro from it. 3) Use weight as the second axis and combine it with size (24px semibold reads higher than 24px regular). 4) In monochrome or one-colour palettes, hierarchy must come from size, weight and space alone. 5) Review: each rank must be distinguishable at a glance from its neighbours. **أرقام / params:** scale ratio
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

#### ACRAFT-19 · الأنماط الأصلية للعلامة والشخصية والتميمة · Brand archetypes for voice, mascot and character design · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يختار نمطاً أصلياً واحداً من اثني عشر (الحكيم، المستكشف، المهرّج…) ليوجّه صوت العلامة وتصميم الشخصية أو التميمة. — Chooses one of twelve archetypes (Sage, Explorer, Jester...) to steer brand voice and mascot or character design.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** تصميم شخصية للعلامة، تميمة، ماسكوت، هوية / mascot design, brand character, brand personality
- **كيف / how:** 1) Name the core motivation first, then map to one archetype: Innocent (safety), Sage (truth), Explorer (freedom), Outlaw (disruption), Magician (transformation), Hero (mastery), Lover (intimacy), Jester (joy), Everyman (belonging), Caregiver, Creator, Ruler. 2) Derive shape language, colour, posture and voice from that motivation (Jester: round forms, bright accents, playful copy). 3) Keep one primary archetype, at most one secondary. 4) Test across cultures: reactions to archetypes vary, so validate with the actual audience. **أرقام / params:** primary archetype

#### ACRAFT-20 · رسم أيقونة التطبيق بالكود · App icon drawn in code as flat layers · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يرسم أيقونة التطبيق من 1-4 أشكال بسيطة بالكود، طبقة لكل شكل، ثم يقارنها بأيقونات النظام بكل المقاسات. — Draws the app icon from 1-4 simple shapes in code, one layer per shape, then previews it beside system icons at every size.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** أيقونة تطبيق، app icon، رسم أيقونة بالكود / app icon, draw icon in code, macOS icon
- **كيف / how:** 1) Say what the app is in one object or scene users recognise. 2) Sketch it as 1-4 shapes on a grid; each shape becomes its own layer. 3) Choose a background gradient and 3-5 accents; dark or saturated fills make light shapes pop. 4) Canvas 1024x1024, keep the artwork in the middle ~60% (at ~78% it looks oversized), draw flat (solid or gentle two-stop gradient) and let the platform add the material. 5) Avoid motifs that read as the platform's own apps. 6) Render previews from 256 down to 16 pt beside system icons before shipping. **أرقام / params:** 1024 canvas, 60% art area
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

#### ACRAFT-21 · تصميم واجهة غير قالبي وملف DESIGN.md · Anti-template interface design and a DESIGN.md north star · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يتجنب الأشكال الافتراضية المكررة للواجهات، ويكتب ملف تصميم واحد واضح الرأي بالألوان والخطوط والتخطيط يرجع إليه البشر والنماذج. — Avoids the stock look of generated interfaces and writes one opinionated design file (palette, type, layout, principles) that people and models follow.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** تصميم موقع مميز، واجهة ليست مكررة، دليل تصميم / distinctive UI, design guide, avoid generic look
- **كيف / how:** 1) Ground the design in the subject matter, not a template. 2) List and avoid default looks: cream + serif + terracotta, near-black + one acid accent, broadsheet hairlines, identical rounded SaaS cards with the same grey shadow, tracked ALL-CAPS eyebrows above every heading, meta strings joined by middle dots. 3) Plan, review against the brief, build, critique: palette as 4-6 named hex values, typefaces and roles, a layout concept compared in ASCII wireframes, then principles. 4) Capture it in DESIGN.md with a theme or north star, the why behind each rule and concrete tokens; hedging guides are ignored. **أرقام / params:** palette 4-6 hex

#### ACRAFT-22 · التفاعلات الدقيقة: المحفّز والقواعد والاستجابة والحلقات · Microinteractions: trigger, rules, feedback, loops and modes · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يصمم التفاصيل الصغيرة للأزرار والمفاتيح والتحميل ويقيّمها بثمانية بنود. — Designs the small details of toggles, buttons and loaders and scores them on eight rows.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** تفاعل زر، حركة صغيرة في الواجهة، micro interaction / microinteraction, button feedback, toggle animation
- **كيف / how:** 1) Trigger: shows that it exists, what it does and its state; prominence matches stakes; gestures get a visible alternative; default/hover/active/disabled/loading states look different. 2) Rules: simple and predictable, constrain inputs instead of erroring. 3) Feedback under 100 ms, scaled to the event's importance (not uniform). 4) Loops and modes: define what repeats or expires, avoid hidden modes. 5) Score 9-10 when all eight rows pass, 5-6 for generic feel, ≤3 when feedback or triggers are missing. **أرقام / params:** feedback < 100 ms
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md
- **الدليل / proof:** `https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3438-ux-design/14121-microinteractions`

#### ACRAFT-24 · الإفصاح التدريجي للمعلومات والأدوات · Progressive disclosure of information and controls · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يقسّم الواجهة أو الشرح إلى طبقات: ما يلزم للقرار الحالي أولاً، والباقي خلف خطوة واحدة. — Layers an interface or explanation: what the current decision needs first, the rest one step away.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** واجهة مزدحمة، إخفاء الخيارات المتقدمة / cluttered UI, advanced options, layered help
- **كيف / how:** 1) Every visible element costs noticing, reading and evaluating. 2) Sort options by frequency and relevance; show the primary layer, tuck advanced ones behind one clear disclosure (expand, 'more', a second step). 3) Make the hidden layer discoverable and its trigger explicit. 4) Do not hide what most users need often, and do not nest more than two levels. 5) Same rule applies to documents and skills: summary first, references one level deep. **أرقام / params:** layers ≤2

## هندسة البرومبت والمهارات — Prompt, skill & plugin engineering

#### ACRAFT-25 · حوكمة البرومبتات في الإنتاج: سجل وتقييمات وترقية وتراجع · Prompt governance: registry, evals, promotion and rollback · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يعامل البرومبتات ككود: سجل بإصدارات وترقية بين البيئات، مجموعة ذهبية وتقييمات آلية في CI، اختبار A/B مسبق التعريف، وتراجع بأمر واحد. — Treats prompts as code: a versioned registry with environment promotion, a golden set with automated evals in CI, pre-defined A/B tests and one-command rollback.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** برومبتات مكتوبة داخل الكود، تراجع جودة بعد تعديل برومبت، اختبار A/B لبرومبت / prompts hard-coded in app code, a prompt change regressed quality, prompt A/B tests
- **كيف / how:** 1) Registry: prompts/<id>/vX.Y.Z.md plus registry.yaml with owner, model, status and who promoted when. 2) A golden dataset per prompt (20 examples minimum, 100+ for production) covering edge cases, reviewed by a domain expert and versioned with the prompt. 3) Pick eval type by task: exact match, contains, schema validation, embedding similarity, model-as-judge, human; set thresholds (e.g. 95% extraction, 100% schema). 4) Lifecycle: branch, develop, eval in CI, compare with production score, review diff plus scores, promote with approval, monitor 24-48 h, rollback. 5) A/B: stable hash assignment, metric and sample size fixed in advance, at least a week or 1,000 requests per arm. 6) Re-run evals on a schedule because model updates break prompts silently.
- **الرخصة / license:** method paraphrased from Atlas skills under MIT; the skills keep their own licenses — see each folder's SOURCE.md

## الكتابة والمحتوى — Writing & content

#### ACRAFT-26 · استخراج أسلوب كاتب إلى دليل أسلوب قابل للتطبيق · Extract a writing style into a reusable style guide · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** يحلل نصًا مصدرًا عبر 17 بعدًا أسلوبيًا (و10 سردية للأدب) من عينات موزعة، وينتج دليلًا وبطاقة صوت وقائمة افعل/لا تفعل ومعيار تقييم. — Analyses a source text across 17 style dimensions (plus 10 narrative ones for fiction) from spread samples and produces a guide, a voice card, a do/don't list and a scoring rubric.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** 'حلل أسلوب هذا الكاتب'، صوت علامة تجارية، كتابة بأسلوب مرجع / analyse an author's voice, brand voice, write in the style of a reference
- **كيف / how:** 1) Sample 5-7 points spread across the text (opening, 25-35%, middle, 65-75%, end), not one chapter. 2) Record patterns, not content, across tone, sentence and paragraph length, register, transitions, humour, directness, warmth, explanation order, openings, closings, punctuation, rhetorical moves, reader address, examples, references and how the style adapts to difficulty. 3) For fiction add plot architecture, time structure, character introduction, emotional conveyance, theme handling, revelation pacing and where the author departs from AI defaults. 4) Keep only features seen in several samples; never claim absent traits. 5) Deliver full guide (800-1500 words), voice card (~300), 20-30 do/don't items and a 1-5 rubric, each with 2-3 neutral passages rewritten in the style. 6) Never copy signature phrases as rules; describe the pattern they exemplify. **أرقام / params:** source text

#### ACRAFT-31 · ملف صوت المالك: قابل للقياس ومدعوم باقتباسات وينمو من تعديلاته · Owner voice file: measurable, quote-backed, grows from edits · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** ملف صوت قصير يصف كيف يكتب/يتكلم المالك بأرقام واقتباسات لا بصفات — Build a ≤150-line voice file from 3–5 of the owner's own pieces that every writing skill loads.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** اكتب بصوتي، الريل لازم يبقى بطريقتي، out/voice.md / write like me, my voice, voice profile, before any reel script
- **كيف / how:** 1) Collect 3–5 of the owner's own pieces in the SAME genre but DIFFERENT topics (same-topic samples narrow the range and hurt); <3 → mark confidence: low; 0 → refuse. 2) Measure, don't describe: median sentence length and spread, shortest sentence, paragraph length, connector rate, concrete-anchor density, dialect markers (مش/هـ/اللي), digit system, dash/emoji rate. 3) Habits section: how he opens, gives examples, signals doubt, closes — each habit must quote one real line; no quote → drop the habit. 4) Never-say list: words/structures that appear 0 times in his samples but are common model defaults, each with his replacement (not just a ban). 5) 3–5 positive excerpts + 1 negative: the model's own default draft on the same topic with a line on what differs (contrastive example). 6) No personality adjectives (دافئ/حاد) — they are not checkable. 7) Use it as completion: continue his text rather than 'imitate his style'. 8) Update loop: after each session diff his edits against the draft; corrections that repeat become new never-say/habit lines with a dated log entry; do not rewrite the whole file. 9) If samples disagree strongly (e.g. caption vs voiceover), keep two profiles instead of averaging. 10) Only the owner's own voice (or a team he represents) — never a named third party. Sources (read as inert text, not copied): https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3597-humanize/14430-voice-profile, https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3034-linkedin-skills/13055-linkedin-humanizer, https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2537-unslop/9835-unslop. **أرقام / params:** 3–5 samples; out/voice.md

#### ACRAFT-32 · إعادة كتابة على مستوى الخطاب مع قارئ بارد معزول · Discourse-level rewrite with an isolated cold reader · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** إصلاح ما يجعل القارئ يفقد الخيط رغم فهمه كل كلمة — Fix the thread, not the vocabulary: old→new flow, topic chain, emphasis position, lists that replace argument; judged by a fresh-context reader.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** النص مفهوم كلمة كلمة بس مش ماشي، القارئ بيتوه / reader loses the thread, reads like AI after word-level cleanup
- **كيف / how:** 1) Three layers: words (WRITE-02/03 scans), syntax (nominalised shells like تم القيام بـ, participle tails, uniform length), discourse (this card). 2) Paragraph checks: first sentence = the paragraph's claim (reading first sentences alone must carry the piece); each sentence starts with something already known and puts the new item at the end; one key term reused, never rotated. 3) Document checks: the trigger/problem with a date or number opens, the decision appears within 3 paragraphs, no closing summary paragraph, delete-test (a paragraph whose removal loses nothing is a repeat), headings as claims not category names. 4) A list whose items depend on each other (premise, cause, trade-off) becomes prose with the relation words; scan-read genres (reports, README, reference) keep their skeleton — edit sentences only and diff heading levels, list item counts and table shapes before/after. 5) The only allowed information gain is digging out specifics already in the source; missing ones become [يحتاج تحقق: …]. 6) Certainty check: count hedges/commitments before and after; 'سوف' must not become 'قد' or vice versa. 7) Review in a separate agent that gets only the rewrite, the reader and the genre (never the source or the brief); it reports per paragraph: expected / got / where lost. 8) Max 2 rounds; still failing → deliver with the list of paragraphs that need the author to add content, not more polishing. 9) For key openings: draft 5 candidates, drop the most predictable one first (typicality bias), then choose. Sources (read as inert text, not copied): https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3597-humanize/14428-humanize, https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2218-majestic-writing/8391-copy-editor. **أرقام / params:** draft, reader, genre

#### ACRAFT-33 · إصلاح الترجمة الحرفية في العربية بعد الترجمة أو التعريب · Arabic translationese repair after translation or localization · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تنعيم نص عربي مترجم دون تغيير معناه أو سجله — Post-edit translated Arabic (scripts, subtitles, UI strings) to remove calques while locking facts, modality and register.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** النص مترجم وباين، ترجمة حرفية، تعريب واجهة، ترجمة سكريبت أو ترجمة / translationese, calques, localize UI, translated subtitles
- **كيف / how:** 1) Translate first, naturalize second; never do both in one pass. For long sources: pin a glossary (key terms, chapter/section titles, names) before translating, translate per section, sanity-check length ratio per section, and read one finished section against the source before running the rest. 2) Mask protected spans byte-for-byte: numbers, dates, URLs, code, names, placeholders like {count}, quotes. 3) Calque families to fix: يلعب دورًا/يعتبر بمثابة → plain verb; من خلال/عن طريق chains; تمّ + مصدر → named actor; بالإضافة إلى ذلك/علاوة على ذلك at every paragraph; human adverbs on programs (بصمت، بشفافية، بأناقة) → say what actually happens; English word order (adjective chains, sentence-final 'حيث'); English punctuation (, ? ; and em dashes). 4) Lock modality: must stays يجب, may stays قد; conditions, negations, order unchanged. 5) Keep register (MSA vs Egyptian) and one spelling/digit convention; do not convert. 6) Edit budget: character change ≲30% normal, 30–50% re-verify every claim, >50% stop — you are rewriting, not naturalizing. 7) UI-string mode suspends the budget: labels become noun phrases, short and uniform within one screen; but never add a behavior or warning the source did not state; unknown term → flag, leave as is. 8) Arabic plural/gender: ICU needs zero/one/two/few/many/other; check every category reads naturally. 9) Optional: keep a per-owner rules file (signal, exception, rewrite) that grows from his corrections; apply only when context matches. 10) Report: final text, then only 'needs check' items. Sources (read as inert text, not copied): https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/880-superloopy/1935-humanize-korean, https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1101-akbun-writing/2489-akbun-writing-naturalize, https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3549-xm/14339-humanize, https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3193-ru-text/13542-ru-text. **أرقام / params:** source+target, glossary

#### ACRAFT-34 · بنك القصص: مقابلة تحفظ الأرقام ونقاط التحول والمواقف · Story bank interview: numbers, turning points, positions · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** مقابلة مرة واحدة تملأ ملفًا دائمًا بالمادة الحقيقية للمحتوى — One structured interview fills a persistent story bank so hooks never need invented facts.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** مش لاقي أقول إيه، اعملي مقابلة، الفكرة رفيعة / interview me, I have nothing to post, thin idea, the one true thing
- **كيف / how:** 1) Read the bank first; ask only thin sections — never re-ask. 2) Open wide with one question and follow what he gets animated about; one question at a time. 3) Press every soft answer exactly once: 'improved' → by how much, over what period; 'a while ago' → which month; 'a big client' → can it be named. 4) Chase the reversal: what he believed a year ago and no longer does, and what it cost. 5) Find the position: what he thinks is true that peers dispute, and the cost of holding it. 6) Collect the 3 stories he already tells in person (pre-tested). 7) Settle naming limits explicitly; 'rather not say' is recorded as off-limits forever. 8) Write verbatim phrasing where vivid, date the file, list thin sections; leave unknown numbers empty, never inferred. 9) Mining a single story: return 3–5 genuinely distinct angles (lesson, contrarian, method, proof, relatable moment) plus 'not worth angling' (e.g. no proof angle until numbers are final); anonymize clients by default; openings start at the surprise/number, never chronology. 10) Post mode: moment not theme → number and date → what he got wrong → who disagrees → what viewer should do; read back a 5-line spine. Sources (read as inert text, not copied): https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3034-linkedin-skills/13056-linkedin-interviewer, https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1520-digital-marketing-pro/4122-story-mine. **أرقام / params:** out/story-bank.md

#### ACRAFT-35 · من شرارة إلى فكرة قابلة للتصوير: احتمالات، لوجلاين، رهانات · From spark to filmable premise: what-ifs, logline tests, stakes · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تحويل صورة أو إحساس إلى فرضية فيلم/ريل تحمل صراعًا — Turn a spark into a premise that can carry a short film or series before any boards.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** عندي فكرة فيلم، لو حصل كذا، هل الفكرة قوية / film idea, what if, is this premise strong, logline
- **كيف / how:** 1) Record the spark in his words and classify it: image, what-if, character, setting, feeling; ask what drew him — that answer must survive later changes. 2) Generate 8–12 what-ifs by angle: invert it, raise the cost, move it in time or place, give it to the wrong person; flag which already imply conflict; he picks 1–3. 3) Logline = protagonist + want + obstacle + stakes. 4) Stress tests, each pass/weak/fail with one reason and one fix: active protagonist, opposition that can win, a choice at the end, personal stakes, situation that sustains the target length (5 s, 30 s, 3 min, series). 5) Stakes on three levels: external, relational, internal; at least two concrete. 6) Controlling idea + its counter-argument as working hypotheses. 7) For a contrarian angle: decompose into falsifiable claims, attack each; if objections reduce it to a tautology it is not an insight; refine to more precise wording, never retreat to weaker. 8) Hand a one-screen brief (title, logline, stakes, form, language/dialect) to STORY-01 intake. Sources (read as inert text, not copied): https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1213-story-skills/2878-premise-workshop, https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1120-ambient-library/2630-hot-take-forge. **أرقام / params:** spark

#### ACRAFT-36 · حرفة مشهد الحوار: نص فرعي، ادخل متأخرًا، فعل مرئي فقط · Dialogue scene craft: subtext, late entry, visible-only action · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** قواعد كتابة مشاهد وحوار لفيلم قصير أو إعلان تمثيلي — Rules and model tells for scripted scenes with characters.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** سكريبت فيه حوار، مشهد بين شخصيتين، فيلم قصير، إعلان تمثيلي / dialogue scene, short film script, screenplay
- **كيف / how:** 1) Every scene: someone wants something, something blocks it, the situation ends changed; outcomes yes-but / no-and / no-but; a clean yes kills tension. 2) Enter late, leave early: cut arrivals, greetings, goodbyes, and the summarizing last line. 3) Action lines in present tense, only what can be seen or heard, ≤3–4 lines; never 'she feels devastated'. 4) Subtext: characters talk around the thing; nobody answers the question directly; nobody explains what both know ('as you know…'). 5) Each character has a verbal signature (rhythm, words, what they never say, register/dialect fixed per pair — a shift is a story event); cover names and you should still know who speaks. 6) Monologues ≤5 lines; one physical reaction at most; withhold one thing per scene. 7) Model tells to scan: characters stating motive or theme, convenient coincidences, emotion on schedule, uniform scene length, final scene mirroring the first with one word changed, metaphors that explain themselves. 8) Timing: ~1 page ≈ 1 minute; for shorts one turn, no subplot. 9) Voiceover/audiobook version: add a pronunciation respelling list for names, and re-read for what fails aloud (visual-only jokes, tables, long untagged dialogue). Sources (read as inert text, not copied): https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1376-velith/3228-book-screenplay, https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1376-velith/3218-book-fiction, https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1213-story-skills/2869-adaptation. **أرقام / params:** scene list

#### ACRAFT-37 · من شذرات إلى سكريبت: استكشاف ثم استغلال · From fragments to a script: explore, then exploit · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** جمع شذرات بلا ترتيب ثم بناء النص فقرة فقرة على مفاهيم مؤسسة — Separate idea-mining from shaping; build explainer scripts block by block on grounded concepts.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** عندي أفكار متفرقة، فويس أوفر شرح، حول ملاحظاتي لسكريبت / scattered notes to script, explainer voiceover
- **كيف / how:** 1) Explore: append every fragment (sharp line, claim, vignette, half-thought, quote) to one file separated by ---; no structure; re-read the file before each write, never overwrite. 2) Hunt the leading word: one coinage or metaphor the whole piece can hang on — it later shapes title and transitions. 3) Exploit in a separate file: agree what the viewer already knows (prerequisites); keep a running list of grounded concepts. 4) Draft 2–3 openings, each implying a different thesis; he picks or merges. 5) Grow block by block: 'given this, what does the viewer need next?'; a block may lean only on grounded concepts — otherwise ground it first. 6) Pull from the pile as a quarry (split, merge, rework); if the pile lacks an example, say so: give one now or cut the section. 7) Ask per block: what does this do that the last didn't; if I cut it what breaks; is this one job or two. 8) For argument-heavy pieces check the pyramid: one-sentence governing answer, 2–4 non-overlapping supports, evidence matched to each, gaps labeled. Sources (read as inert text, not copied): https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2224-mattpocock-skills/8433-writing-fragments, https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2224-mattpocock-skills/8434-writing-shape, https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2218-majestic-writing/8394-minto-pyramid. **أرقام / params:** notes file

#### ACRAFT-38 · مراجعة الكوبي في سبعة تمريرات مع إعادة التحقق · Seven-sweep copy review with revalidation · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** مراجعة نص تسويقي/كابشن بتمريرات منفصلة لكل بُعد — Review existing copy one dimension per pass, re-checking earlier passes after each fix.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** راجع الكابشن، حسن النص الإعلاني، الكوبي ضعيف / review my caption, improve ad copy
- **كيف / how:** 0) Mechanical pass first: throat-clearing openers (في عالم اليوم، لا يخفى على أحد), binary contrast (مش بس… ده), dramatic fragments (وبس. كده.), empty jargon, stacked triads; report density per 100 words (<0.5 ok, 0.5–1.5 revise, >1.5 rewrite the passage). 1) Clarity: mark what doesn't land on first read before proposing. 2) Voice: audit against the voice file; compare start vs end for tone drift. 3) So-what: every claim answers why the viewer should care. 4) Prove: superlatives need a source; no proof → soften the claim, never invent it. 5) Specificity: vague → numbers/timeframes from the source; can't be specific → cut. 6) Emotion: concrete before-state, no fake urgency. 7) Zero risk near the CTA: unanswered objection, unclear next step. After each sweep re-run the earlier ones. Output: per-line current/proposed/reason, a 'kept on purpose' list, then the full revised text. Severity: high = meaning/legal/hidden action, medium = comprehension/trust, low = polish. Sources (read as inert text, not copied): https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2964-pwdev-copy/12451-copy-review, https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2218-majestic-writing/8391-copy-editor. **أرقام / params:** copy, voice file

## هندسة البرومبت والمهارات — Prompt, skill & context engineering

#### ACRAFT-27 · طابق شكل التعليمة مع نوع الفشل واختبر الصياغة باختبارات دقيقة · Match the instruction form to the failure, then micro-test the wording · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** قبل كتابة أي قاعدة في مهارة أو برومبت، صنّف الفشل الملاحظ واختر الشكل المناسب له (منع، وصفة، خانة إلزامية، شرط)، ثم اختبر الصياغة مقابل نسخة بلا توجيه. — Classify the observed failure, pick the instruction form that fixes that failure type, and micro-test the wording against a no-guidance control before shipping it.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** كتابة قاعدة في مهارة، البرومبت يتجاهل تعليمة، المخرج شكله غلط / writing a rule into a skill or prompt, a rule keeps being ignored, output has the wrong shape
- **كيف / how:** 1) Run the task without the new guidance first; if the failure does not appear, write nothing. 2) Classify the failure: skips a known rule under pressure → short prohibition plus a table of the excuses seen and a red-flags list; right behaviour but wrong output shape → a positive recipe that states the parts of the output in order (prohibitions here make it worse); a required element is missing → a required slot in the template being filled; behaviour should depend on a condition → a conditional keyed to an observable fact ('if the brief exists, cite it'). 3) No nuance clauses ('don't X unless it matters') and no exemption clauses ('this limit doesn't apply to code'): they reopen negotiation or leak; restructure so the rule cannot reach the exempt part. 4) Give every rule its reason in one clause; reasons transfer to unseen cases where bare rules do not. 5) End a reference list with a non-exhaustive licence ('covers common cases; reason from the whys'), and mark any enumerated read-list as a floor, otherwise the list becomes the model's blind spot. 6) Prefer a strong pretrained word ('tight', 'red', 'relentless') over a restated triad; say the target behaviour positively and keep negatives only as hard guardrails. 7) Micro-test: one fresh context per sample, the real surrounding skill as context, a task that tempts the failure, 5+ samples per variant plus the no-guidance control; read every flagged hit by hand. 8) Variance is a metric: if 5 samples give 5 interpretations, tighten the form before adding words. 9) Calm craft register: threat/urgency language and ALL-CAPS drive corner-cutting. Failure modes go in the skill only after they really happened. Sources (read as inert text, not copied): https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2679-superpowers/10268-writing-skills, https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1457-aegis/3581-writing-skills, https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3419-wix/14000-writing-great-skills, https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3121-batterie/13382-skill-forge. **أرقام / params:** failure sample, candidate wordings, 5+ reps per arm

#### ACRAFT-28 · صمّم شكل المهارة: نمط الاستدعاء وتصنيف الخطوات ومعيار الإنجاز وقسم المطبّات · Design a skill's shape: invocation mode, step typing, completion criteria, growing gotchas · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** قرارات بنية المهارة قبل كتابة نصها: من يستدعيها، أي خطوة كود وأيها استدلال وأيها قرار بشري، ومتى تُعتبر كل خطوة منتهية. — Structural decisions for a skill before writing prose: who invokes it, which steps are code vs model reasoning vs human decision, and a checkable done-condition per step.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** إنشاء مهارة جديدة أو تقسيم مهارة كبيرة / creating a new skill, splitting a big skill, a skill whose steps get rushed
- **كيف / how:** 1) Pick one category per skill (reference, verification, data/analysis, automation, scaffolding, review, deploy, runbook, ops); a skill straddling several is confused. 2) Invocation: model-invoked only if the agent or another skill must reach it alone (its description is paid every turn); otherwise user-invoked with a one-line human description, and when manual skills multiply add one router skill. 3) Description = trigger condition with one phrase per distinct branch, the neighbour skill named in a NOT-for clause; never a workflow summary. 4) Type each step code / inference / hybrid / human; any output that must be byte-identical on rerun (tables, sorting, templates) goes to a script; every inference step states input, output and why code can't do it. 5) Who-does-what table plus explicit human confirmation points; never proceed on silence; missing values stay null, unreadable inputs go to a separate list. 6) Each step ends with a checkable, exhaustive completion criterion ('every modified file accounted for'); if the agent still rushes, split the later steps out so they are not in view. 7) Hub SKILL.md short; spokes one level deep, each link saying when to read it; inline what every branch needs, push behind pointers what only some branches use. 8) Start a Gotchas section and add one line every time Claude trips; it becomes the highest-signal part. 9) First-run setup in a config file (ask if missing); persistent state outside the skill folder; optional session-scoped hooks for guardrails. 10) Status labels honestly: needs-verification until behaviour was tested. Sources (read as inert text, not copied): https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2462-playbooks/9547-skill-authoring, https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2462-playbooks/9548-thariq-skills, https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3419-wix/14000-writing-great-skills, https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/114-discovery/299-writing-skills. **أرقام / params:** skill purpose, trigger examples

#### ACRAFT-29 · أعد هيكلة مهارة كبيرة دون فقدان سلوكها: سجل الثوابت ومصدر واحد للحقيقة · Refactor a large skill without losing behaviour: invariant ledger, single source of truth, earned labels · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** تقليص وتنظيم مهارة أو ملف تعليمات طويل مع حفظ المحفزات والقواعد الأمنية والبدائل، ودمج النصوص المكررة في مصدر واحد بقاعدة الثلاث. — Shrink and reorganise a long skill or instruction file while preserving triggers, safety rules and fallbacks, deduplicating repeated prose into one source only under the Rule of Three.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** المهارة طويلة ومكررة، قواعد متناقضة بين الملفات، تنظيف دوري للتعليمات / skill is long or repetitive, rules contradict across files, periodic instruction cleanup
- **كيف / how:** 1) Baseline: lines, chars, approx tokens, trigger and no-trigger cases, and an invariant ledger (triggers, counter-triggers, safety/authorization rules, tool fallbacks, stop and honesty criteria, output contract), each marked confirmed/inferred/unknown. Snapshot the files first. 2) Findings by class with line refs: duplication, contradiction (core vs reference), unconditional reading, over-broad or narrow description, steps no requirement explains, internal inconsistencies (numbering, terms, stale refs). 3) Dedup: classify each file as DESCRIBE (owns the concept), USE (must cite it by exact heading) or EXPOSE (may restate for humans with a pointer); create a new shared file only at 3+ real instances found by your own grep; at 1–2 instances only trim-to-citation, normalize wording or name an owner. 4) A block moved out of the core takes its guard rules and required terms with it; pointers one level deep; no ../ or symlinks across components. 5) For test-verifiable fixes write failing assertions first, then edit, then green. 6) Three sequential reviews: contract & safety; selection & disclosure; metrics & portability; re-check each fix. 7) Re-measure on the same cases; size reduction never pays for a lost invariant or a lost trigger. 8) Close with only the labels earned: refactored, statically validated, behaviorally evaluated (only after paired runs). 9) For scheduled sweeps: one commit per file with a ledger of cuts; files from a rejected earlier sweep are skipped next time; never edit frontmatter or fenced code in a tightening pass. Sources (read as inert text, not copied): https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2975-pwdev-skills/12576-skill-refactor, https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2972-pwdev-power/12533-power-skill-refactor, https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2434-docs-hygiene/9449-extract-ssot, https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1547-plugin-creator/4290-shared-content-references. **أرقام / params:** target skill path, eval cases

#### ACRAFT-30 · حوّل جلسة ناجحة إلى مهارة سير عمل قابلة للإعادة · Skillify a finished session into a reusable workflow skill · 📄 موصوف / documented only
- **ماذا / what:** بعد إنجاز عمل متكرر (مونتاج ريل، حزمة برومبتات)، استخرج خطواته ومدخلاته ومعايير نجاح كل خطوة وتصحيحات المستخدم إلى مهارة، أو إلى ذاكرة إن كان مجرد معلومة. — After a repeated job is done, capture its steps, inputs, per-step success criteria and the user's corrections as a skill — or as a memory note if it is only a fact.
- **متى أستخدمها / when:** 'احفظ ده كمهارة'، 'إيه اللي اتعلمناه'، نفس الشغل اتكرر في أكثر من جلسة / 'save this as a skill', 'what did we learn', same workflow repeated across sessions
- **كيف / how:** 1) Gate: a repeatable multi-step procedure with judgment calls → skill; a single cause→fix, gotcha or config fact → memory/one-line rule, not a skill (most learnings are memory). Must be reusable, non-trivial, specific and verified to have worked. 2) Evidence: prefer repeated occurrences across sessions (same instructions repeated, recurring corrections, near-misses of an existing skill) over one session; weak evidence → no recommendation; an existing skill that fits → update it. 3) Analyze before asking: inputs, ordered steps, artifacts each step hands on, where the user steered or corrected, tools and permissions used. 4) Interview briefly in rounds only as needed: name + trigger phrases; goal and success criteria; step list and inline vs forked execution; per non-obvious step what proves it is done and whether to pause for the user (irreversible actions, publishing, paid generation). 5) Write: every step gets a Success criteria line; optional Artifacts, Human checkpoint, Rules (from the user's corrections), parallel steps as 3a/3b; minimum tool permissions. 6) Show a plain confirmation card (name, trigger, inputs, output, checkpoints, acceptance checks) and the full file before saving. 7) Never overwrite an existing skill; diff it. Strip client data, paths with usernames and secrets. 8) Validate structure and run 5 should-trigger and 3 should-not-trigger prompts plus one real end-to-end run; report separately what is structurally valid vs proven by a run. Sources (read as inert text, not copied): https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1120-ambient-library/2585-system-prompt-skillify-current-session, https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/3285-claudeception/13796-claudeception, https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/2487-codex-operations/9651-find-skill-candidates, https://github.com/kosif199022-jpg/kosif-atlas/tree/main/skills/1544-agentskill-kaizen/4235-kaizen-improvement. **أرقام / params:** session transcript or summary, target location
